# `react/workspace/PatternChipsSection`

One type: a pattern the host offers, with the id it is keyed on and the label shown. The
library carries no pattern name of its own — naming a pattern names your business.

## Example

```ts
import type { CandlePatternChoice } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

declare const choices: readonly CandlePatternChoice[];

export const first: CandlePatternChoice | undefined = choices[0];
```

## Exports

- **`CandlePatternChoice`** · type · `interface CandlePatternChoice { id: string; label: string; name?: string | undefined }`
